subject: Polity
question: Consider the following statements : a. The post of the Sarpanch (who is elected by the members of Gram Panchayat) or Upa Sarpanch, as the case may be, that has fallen vacant (due to resignation) shall be filled in within thirty days from the date of such vacancy. b. The post of the directly elected Sarpanch that has fallen vacant shall be filled within three months from the date of such vacancy. c. A member of a Gram Panchayat whose post has become vacant due to absence for continuous meetings of the Gram Panchayat shall not be eligible for re-election. Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Under Maharashtra's Gram Panchayat rules, a Sarpanch or Upa-Sarpanch vacancy caused by resignation must be filled within thirty days — statement (a) holds. A directly elected Sarpanch vacancy follows a longer election cycle (not the three-month rule in (b)), and absence from meetings alone does not permanently bar re-election as (c) claims.

subject: Polity
question: Consider the following statements about the provisions of the Village Development Committees of Maharashtra Gram Panchayat Act : a. The total number of members in a Village Development Committee shall not be less than seven and not more than seventeen. b. Not less than one-third of its members shall be from amongst the members of the Gram Panchayat. c. Not less than one-half of the members shall be women. d. The Deputy Sarpanch shall be its ex-officio chairman. e. Gram Sevak shall be its ex-officio member-secretary. Which of the statements given above are correct ?

options.A: Only a, b, c and d
options.C: Only a, b, c and e

explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. A Village Development Committee must have at least one-third members from the Gram Panchayat, at least half women, and the Gram Sevak as ex-officio member-secretary — (b), (c), and (e). The member ceiling in (a) and making the Deputy Sarpanch ex-officio chairman in (d) do not match the Act.

subject: Polity
question: The 'Sarkaria Commission' favoured _______.

options.A: abolition of the office of the Governor

explanation: The verified answer here is option D. The Sarkaria Commission (1983) reviewed Centre–State relations and recommended stronger cooperation — it did not call for abolishing the Governor, All India Services, or the Inter-State Council. All three options describe abolition the Commission never favoured.

subject: Polity
question: Assertion (A) : Legislative control over administration in a Parliamentary system is different from that of Presidential system. Reason (B) : An important feature of democratic government is the legislative control over administration.

options.A: Both 'A' and 'B' are true and 'B' is the correct explanation of 'A'.
options.B: Both 'A' and 'B' are true, but 'B' is not the correct explanation of 'A'.

explanation: On this one, option B. Both assertions are true: parliamentary and presidential systems exercise legislative control over the executive differently, and democratic government does involve such control. But (B) states a general democratic fact — it does not explain why the two systems differ, so it is not the correct explanation of (A).

subject: Reasoning
question: Which one of the following statements is correct about the Advocate General of the State ?

options.A: He shall hold office during the pleasure of the State Council of Ministers.
options.B: His remuneration is determined by the State Legislature.
options.C: He may appear as an advocate in cases against the State Government for a private party.

explanation: The right pick is option D. The Advocate General holds office during the Governor's pleasure (not the Council of Ministers), remuneration is fixed by the Governor (not the Legislature), and he cannot appear against the State Government for a private party — so none of (A)–(C) stands.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following statements related to 'Money Bill' is/are correct ? a. It can be introduced either by a minister or by a private member. b. It cannot be introduced except on the recommendation of the Governor. c. If any question arises whether the bill is a money bill or not, the decision of the Governor is final. d. In case of a deadlock over a money bill, the Governor can summon a joint sitting of Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council. Answer Options :
explanation: Go with option B. At the state level a Money Bill can be introduced only on the Governor's recommendation — that is (b) alone. Private members cannot introduce it ((a) wrong), the Speaker (not the Governor) decides money-bill disputes ((c) wrong), and there is no joint sitting route for a state money-bill deadlock ((d) wrong).

subject: Polity
question: The Parliament of India acquires the power to legislate on any subject on the State List in national interest if a resolution to that effect is passed by the

options.A: Lok Sabha by a majority of its total membership.
options.B: Lok Sabha by a majority of not less than two-thirds of its total membership.
options.C: Rajya Sabha by a majority of its total membership.
options.D: Rajya Sabha by a majority of not less than two-thirds of its members present and voting.

explanation: Pick option D. Article 249 empowers Parliament to legislate on a State List subject when the Rajya Sabha passes a resolution by not less than two-thirds of the members present and voting — not a simple Lok Sabha majority, and not two-thirds of the Rajya Sabha's total strength.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the pairs : A B a. Balshastri Jambhekar I. Establishment of Widow Home b. Gopal Hari Deshmukh II. First supporter of female education c. Mahatma Jyotiba Phule III. Congregation for remarriage d. Maharshi Dhondo Keshav Karve IV. Orphanage Answer Options :
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Balshastri Jambhekar backed early female education (a–II); Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh worked for widow remarriage (b–III); Jyotiba Phule ran orphanage and social institutions (c–IV); Maharshi Karve founded the Widow Home (d–I). That full set is option B.

subject: Polity
question: Generally, the High Court of a State consists of a Chief Justice and _______.

options.B: such other Judges as may be determined by the Governor
options.C: such other Judges as may be determined by the Parliament
options.D: such other Judges as may be determined by the President

explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Article 216 says every High Court consists of a Chief Justice and such other Judges as the President may from time to time deem necessary — not a fixed bench of nine, nor a number fixed by the Governor or Parliament alone.

subject: General Studies
question: Narayan Meghaji Lokhande presented the questions of workers in which of the following newspapers ?
explanation: The right pick is option C. Narayan Meghaji Lokhande — Maharashtra's pioneer trade-union organiser — raised mill-workers' demands through the newspaper Deenbandhu from the 1880s. Samachar Chandrika, Prabhakar, and Dnyanprakash were other periodicals, not his labour platform.

subject: Polity
question: The Constituent Assembly appointed a number of committees to deal with different tasks and works of Constitution-making. Who was the Chairman of the Rules of Procedure Committee ?
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Dr Rajendra Prasad chaired the Constituent Assembly's Rules of Procedure Committee. Ambedkar headed the Drafting Committee; Alladi Krishnaswami Ayyar and K.M. Munshi were on drafting work but not this particular chairmanship.

subject: General Studies
question: Match the following : A B a. Pandita Ramabai I. 'Stree-Purush Tulana' Book b. Ramabai Ranade II. Establishment of Nirashrit Seva Sadan c. Tarabai Shinde III. Establishment of Sharada Sadan d. Janakka Shinde IV. Establishment of 'Hindu Ladies Social Club' Answer Options :
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Pandita Ramabai opened Sharada Sadan (a–III); Ramabai Ranade helped start the Hindu Ladies Social Club (b–IV); Tarabai Shinde authored Stree-Purush Tulana (c–I); Janakka Shinde was linked to Nirashrit Seva Sadan (d–II).

subject: General Studies
question: Paramhans Sabha was established at Mumbai in 1849 and gave the emphasis on the following reforms : a. Widow Remarriage b. Women's Education c. Break the Caste Barrier d. Acceptance of Idol Worship Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: On this one, option C. Paramhans Sabha (1849, Mumbai), founded by Dadoba Pandurang, stressed breaking caste barriers and rejected idol worship. Widow remarriage, women's education, and accepting idol worship were not its programme — only (c) fits.

subject: Polity
question: Match the following regarding and emergence of Indian workers and Labour movement : A B a. Narayan Meghaji Lokhande I. First President of All India Trade Union Congress b. Mahatma Gandhi II. Establishment of Madras Labour Union c. B.P. Wadia III. Establishment of Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association d. Lala Lajpat Rai IV. Placed the problems of labour through Deenbandhu newspaper Answer Options :
explanation: Go with option A. Lokhande publicised labour issues in Deenbandhu (a–IV); Gandhi built the Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association (b–III); B.P. Wadia helped form the Madras Labour Union (c–II); Lala Lajpat Rai became the first president of the All India Trade Union Congress (d–I).

subject: Economy
question: Who made the following thoughts/statements regarding the effects of colonialism on Indians ? a. Indian economy ran overseas. b. Due to economic abstraction, world known enriched India became poverty stricken. c. An exploitation of Indian economy is like Ransom. d. By taking sword in hand it is time to manage our business. Answer Options :

options.A: a-Ramesh Chandra Dutt, b-Justice Ranade, c-Sir George Oxenden, d-Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh
options.B: a-Justice Ranade, b-Sir George Oxenden, c-Ramesh Chandra Dutt, d-Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh
options.C: a-Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh, b-Ramesh Chandra Dutt, c-Justice Ranade, d-Sir George Oxenden
options.D: a-Justice Ranade, b-Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh, c-Sir George Oxenden, d-Ramesh Chandra Dutt

explanation: Pick option C. Lokhitwadi Gopal Hari Deshmukh argued the Indian economy was run for overseas benefit (a); R.C. Dutt showed how a once-rich India was reduced to poverty through economic drain (b); Justice Ranade compared colonial exploitation to ransom (c); Sir George Oxenden's line about taking the sword to manage our own business closes the set (d).

subject: General Studies
question: According to Dadabhai Naoroji, 'What was being drained out was _______, that could generate more economic development if invested in India.' Fill in the blanks with the given right option.
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Dadabhai Naoroji's 'drain of wealth' thesis held that what Britain extracted was India's potential surplus — income that, if invested at home, could have fuelled further development. Handicrafts, currency alone, or cotton output alone miss his core economic argument.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following crops production increased due to commercialization of agriculture during British Period ? a. Tea, Wheat b. Sugarcane, Cotton c. Jute, Indigo d. Tobacco, Opium Which of the statements given above are correct ?
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Under commercial agriculture the British pushed export-oriented crops — sugarcane and cotton, jute and indigo, tobacco and opium ((b), (c), (d)). Tea expansion and wheat as a paired commercialisation claim in (a) is the weak link here.

subject: General Studies
question: Which award was given to Pandita Ramabai by the British Government ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. The British Government honoured Pandita Ramabai with the Kaisar-i-Hind medal for her social and humanitarian work. The other option spellings are not the actual imperial award title.

subject: General Studies
question: Who was the first leader of the revolution of native for farmers ? a. Baba Bhand b. Bijania c. Kajara Singh d. Tantya Bhilla Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: The right pick is option D. Tantya Bhilla (Tantia Bhil) led one of the earliest armed peasant/tribal revolts against oppressive land revenue — treated in Maharashtra history as the first major leader of the native farmers' rebellion. Baba Bhand, Bijania, and Kajara Singh do not carry that 'first leader' tag in standard texts.

subject: General Studies
question: The Civil Rebellion began from which of the following regions ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. The Civil Rebellion phase of 1857 spread earliest and most intensely from Bengal and Bihar — the sepoy mutiny at Meerut linked with civilian uprisings across the Gangetic heartland before rippling elsewhere.

subject: General Studies
question: The longest National Highway in India is _______.
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. NH 44 — earlier numbered NH 7 — runs Srinagar to Kanyakumari and is India's longest highway at roughly 4,000 km. NH 1, NH 48, and NH 6 are major corridors but shorter than this north–south trunk route.

subject: History
question: Which of the following statements are true regarding the Revolt of 1857 ? a. With treacherous attitude Pant Sachiv of Bhor Chimnaji Raghunath (first) tendered Rango Bapuji Gupte to Britishers. b. Rani Bakabai of Nagpur Bhosale Dynasty supported the revolters. c. Chimasaheb of Kolhapur Chhatrapati Dynasty participated in revolt. d. Son of Rango Bapuji Gupte Sitarampant and Ramji Shirsal of Sawantwadi also participated in the Revolt. Answer Options :
explanation: On this one, option C. In Maharashtra's 1857 story, Pant Sachiv Chimnaji Raghunath of Bhor betrayed Rango Bapuji Gupte (a); Kolhapur's Chhatrapati Chimasaheb joined the revolt (c); Sitarampant (Rango's son) and Ramji Shirsal of Sawantwadi took part (d). Rani Bakabai of Nagpur did not support the rebels — so (b) is excluded.

subject: General Studies
question: The salient features of Aurangabad Industrial City : a. Well-planned and greenfield smart city. b. The abbreviation is AURIC. c. The total investment will be ₹ 1,000 crs. d. It is a part of Delhi-Mumbai industrial corridor. Choose the correct option :
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. AURIC is a DMIC-linked greenfield smart city and its name stands for Aurangabad Industrial City — (a), (b), and (d) hold. Statement (c) fixing total investment at exactly ₹1,000 crore understates the phased project outlay in official briefs.

subject: Geography
question: Match the Industrial Regions and Industrial Areas : District Irrigation Scheme a. Nashik I. Butibori b. Kolhapur II. Shendra c. Nagpur III. Vinchur d. Aurangabad IV. Hupari Answer Options :
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Nashik pairs with Vinchur (III), Kolhapur with Hupari (IV), Nagpur with Butibori (I), and Aurangabad with Shendra (II) — each district mapped to its recognised MIDC/industrial node. Ignore the misprinted 'Irrigation Scheme' header; match the industrial-area names the list gives.

subject: General Studies
question: India's population growth and temporal changes during 1981 to 2011 indicates the population transition stage of

options.A: Period of High growth with declining trend

explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Between 1981 and 2011 India's population kept growing in absolute terms but the growth rate was slowing — fertility fell and the curve shows high growth with a declining trend, not rapid acceleration or stagnation.

subject: General Studies
question: Which State of India accounted for the second rank in National Highway length as per report of Basic Road Statistics of India, 2017 ?
explanation: On this one, option D. Basic Road Statistics of India (2017) placed Uttar Pradesh second among states in National Highway length — Maharashtra often leads the table, but UP held the second slot in that report year.

subject: Geography
question: Which one of the following regions indicates the example of high intensity zone of earthquake in India ?

options.B: Himalayan Belt from Kashmir to Assam

explanation: Go with option B. The Himalayan belt from Kashmir to Assam sits in India's highest seismic-intensity zone — young collision tectonics and repeated great earthquakes. The Peninsula, central block, and Ganga plain are comparatively lower-intensity on standard zoning maps.

subject: Geography
question: Match the correct pairs of Irrigation Schemes and Districts in Maharashtra : District Irrigation Scheme a. Satara I. Mukane b. Nashik II. Vishnupuri c. Nanded III. Kanher d. Yavatmal IV. Bembala Answer Options :
explanation: Pick option B. Kanher belongs to Satara (III), Mukane to Nashik (I), Vishnupuri to Nanded (II), and Bembala to Yavatmal (IV) — option B gives a–III, b–I, c–II, d–IV. Swapping Mukane to Satara or Kanher to Nashik breaks the standard Maharashtra irrigation map.

subject: General Studies
question: The State which produces natural gas and mineral oil in India is _______.
explanation: The right pick is option D. Assam — Digboi and the broader Brahmaputra valley — produces both mineral oil and natural gas among the states listed. Kerala, Himachal Pradesh, and Goa lack comparable hydrocarbon production profiles in Indian energy geography.

subject: Geography
question: On the basis of soil formation, the first detailed and scientific soil classification of Maharashtra was done in 1938 by :
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Dr Basu and Dr Shirur carried out the first detailed scientific soil classification of Maharashtra in 1938. Smith, Kellogg–Thorp, and Dokuchaev belong to global or foreign classification traditions, not this state-specific survey.

subject: General Studies
question: Which creeks are included in the 'Central Konkan' of Maharashtra's Konkan Regional Division ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Central Konkan in Maharashtra's regional division covers Rajapuri, Bankot, and Kelshi creeks — mid-coast estuaries between the southern and northern Konkan blocks. Deogarh–Karli, Dharamtar–Terekhol, and Dahanu–Vasai sets belong to other subdivisions.

subject: General Studies
question: The Laccadive islands and Minicoy islands are separated by
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. The Nine Degree Channel separates the Laccadive island group from Minicoy in the Lakshadweep archipelago. Eight Degree Channel lies further north; Ten Degree separates Andaman from Nicobar.

subject: Geography
question: As per G.T. Trewartha's climate classification, Western Coastal Plain and Tripura State exhibit which of the following types of climate ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. In G T Trewartha's scheme the western coastal plain and Tripura fall under tropical monsoon (Am) climate — heavy seasonal rain in humid tropics. Humid mountain, tropical arid, and humid sub-tropical codes fit Himalayan, desert, or interior settings, not this pairing.

subject: Economy
question: _______ was introduced in 1995 for inexpensive and speedy settlement of bank customer disputes.
explanation: Go with option C. The Banking Ombudsman Scheme, introduced in 1995, gives bank customers an inexpensive and speedy forum for dispute redress — RBI's dedicated grievance layer. Prudential norms, customer-service committees, and accounting standards serve different regulatory functions.

subject: Geography
question: Which of the following percentage indicates the proportion of rain received in Maharashtra from North-Western monsoon ?
explanation: On this one, option C. According to the answer key, about 85% of Maharashtra's annual rainfall comes from the southwest monsoon current — the bulk of the state's precipitation budget in standard geography texts. The stem says 'North-Western monsoon'; if your textbook wording differs, defer to the key figure of 85%.

subject: General Studies
question: Consider the following statements : a. After Independence, the Government of India appointed the National Income Committee in August, 1948. b. The committee consisted of Prof. P.C. Mahalanobis, Prof. D.R. Gadgil and Prof. V.K.R.V. Rao. c. The first report of the National Income Committee appeared in 1951 and the final report in 1954. Which of the statements given above is/are incorrect ? Answer Options :
explanation: Pick option A. The National Income Committee did include Mahalanobis, Gadgil, and V K R V Rao and its reports came in 1951 and 1954 — (b) and (c) stand. Statement (a) alone is keyed incorrect, likely over the August 1948 appointment date versus the accepted 1949 chronology in standard accounts.

subject: Economy
question: _______ is the apex organisation to provide credit for the promotion of agriculture and allied activities in rural areas.
explanation: The right pick is option C. NABARD is the apex body for promoting agricultural and allied rural credit through cooperatives and regional rural banks. RBI regulates; SBI is a commercial bank — neither carries NABARD's distinct apex refinance mandate.

subject: Economy
question: Which of the following market segments is growth and profit oriented in the Indian Commercial Banking System ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Indian commercial banks treat retail banking — personal accounts, loans, cards, and cross-sell — as the high-growth, profit-oriented segment. Mutual funds, mobile, and internet channels support delivery but retail drives the margin story the syllabus highlights.

subject: Geography
question: According to the 2011 Census, the density of population in the country is _______.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Census 2011 put India's population density at 382 persons per square kilometre — up from 325 in 2001. The 117, 157, and 282 figures belong to earlier decades or misquoted averages, not the all-India 2011 headline.

subject: Economy
question: What is the biggest source of income for the Central Government in the Union Budget 2021 – 22 ?
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. In Union Budget 2021–22, borrowing and other liabilities formed the largest single receipt head — ahead of GST, income tax, or corporate tax individually — reflecting pandemic-year deficit financing through market borrowings.

subject: General Studies
question: Productivity in Indian agriculture is mainly dependent on two sets of factors. Those are : a. Technological Factors b. Human Resource c. Institutional Factors d. Irrigation Facilities Answer Options :
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Agricultural productivity in India is mainly explained by technological inputs — seeds, mechanisation, plant protection — and institutional factors such as land tenure, credit, extension, and marketing. Human-resource or irrigation-only pairings capture partial drivers, not the keyed dual set.

subject: Economy
question: Which of the following is/are the objectives of Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act, 2003 ? a. To set limits on government borrowings under a time-bound programme. b. To achieve zero revenue deficit and bring down fiscal deficits. c. To make the government responsible for ensuring long term macroeconomic stability. d. Improving transparency in the fiscal operations of the government. Answer Options :
explanation: On this one, option B. The FRBM Act 2003 sets borrowing limits on a time-bound path, targets zero revenue deficit and lower fiscal deficit, secures long-term macro stability, and improves fiscal transparency — all four objectives appear in the statute, so 'all of the above' is the match.

subject: General Studies
question: According to Chief Economic Advisor Krishnamurthy Subramaniam (Economic Survey 2020-21), what may be the shape of Economic recovery ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Chief Economic Adviser Krishnamurthy Subramanian, in the Economic Survey 2020-21, argued India's rebound after the COVID shock could follow a V-shaped recovery — a sharp fall followed by a relatively quick upturn.

subject: Reasoning
question: Which of the following is not an important objective of Special Economic Zones in India ?
explanation: Go with option C. SEZ policy aims at extra economic activity, exports, and employment through industrial and tax incentives — not primary-sector agriculture development. Agriculture sits outside the export-processing and manufacturing logic SEZ notifications emphasise.

subject: General Studies
question: The infant mortality rate is the number of deaths of children under _______ of age in a given geographical area during a given year, per 1000 live births.
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Infant mortality rate counts deaths of children under one year of age per 1,000 live births in a given area and year — not one month, week, or day.

subject: Economy
question: What is the range of tax rates for taxable income as per the Union Budget, 2020 of India ?
explanation: The right pick is option C. Union Budget 2020 retained the new personal income-tax slabs with rates from 5% up to 30% on taxable income — not 25%, 35%, or a 20% ceiling.

subject: Science
question: A neutron having energy of 0.025 eV is a/an _______.
explanation: On this one, option A. A neutron with about 0.025 eV energy is at room-temperature thermal energy — the slow neutrons used in thermal reactors — not epithermal, fast, or merely 'slow' in the loose sense.

subject: Reasoning
question: Consider the following statements : a. International trade is based on differences in prices of goods and services from country to country. b. The terms of trade refer to the exchange ratio of export and import goods or their price ratio. c. The Balance of Payments record in International Trade is maintained in a standard double entry book-keeping method. Which of the statements given above are correct ? Answer Options :
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. International trade rests on cross-country price differences (a); terms of trade measure export–import price ratios (b); and the balance of payments is kept in standard double-entry form (c) — all three statements stand.

subject: General Studies
question: Transfer of heat from a body at low temperature to a body at higher temperature is

options.B: possible by keeping both the bodies in contact
options.C: possible by doing some external work

explanation: Go with option C. Heat will not flow spontaneously from a colder to a hotter body, but a refrigerator or heat pump can move it that way by doing external work — exactly what the Second Law allows.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following statements are correct ? a. The price of electricity for Indian households is lowest in the world. b. The price of electricity for Indian industries is highest in the world. c. Cost recovery in distribution of power is satisfactory in India. Answer Options :
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Economic Survey data do not support any of the three claims: household power is not the world's cheapest, industrial tariffs are not the world's highest, and cost recovery in distribution remains weak — so none of a, b, or c holds.

subject: General Studies
question: The minimum audible frequency of sound means
explanation: Pick option B. The minimum audible frequency is the lower pitch limit of human hearing — roughly 20 Hz — not threshold intensity (loudness) or the upper pitch cut-off.

subject: Science
question: Amoeba is a protozoan animal because a. it is a cellular animal without tissues and organs. b. it is the simplest and most primitive of all animals. c. pseudopodia is present for locomotion. d. it is a pore-bearing animal. Which of the statement/s given above is/are correct ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Amoeba is a single-celled protozoan without tissues or organs (a), among the simplest animals (b), and moves by pseudopodia (c) — pore-bearing (d) describes sponges, not amoeba.

subject: General Studies
question: Diamond is a _______.
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Diamond is a covalent network crystal — each carbon bonded tetrahedrally in a giant lattice — not metallic, ionic, or a simple molecular crystal.

subject: Reasoning
question: The high strength-to-weight ratio of _______ alloy mainly recommends their use in aircraft and automobile industries.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Light aluminium alloys give high strength for low weight, which is why aircraft and automobile bodies rely on them more than on light steel, titanium, or copper.

subject: General Studies
question: In lower atmosphere, smog is formed by the reaction between hydrocarbon and nitrogen oxide. This interaction produces _______ as secondary pollutants.
explanation: The right pick is option D. Photochemical smog from hydrocarbons and nitrogen oxides yields a full basket of secondary pollutants — ozone, aldehydes, ketones, and peroxyacyl nitrates (PAN) — not just one or two classes.

subject: General Studies
question: Choose the correct pair/pairs of the animal/animals and their scientific name/names ? a. Asiatic lion — Panthera leo persica b. Royal Bengal Tiger — Panthera tigris c. Indian Rhinoceros — Rhinoceros unicornis d. Thamin Deer — Cervus eldi Answer Options :
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. All four pairings check out: Asiatic lion — Panthera leo persica; Royal Bengal Tiger — Panthera tigris; Indian Rhinoceros — Rhinoceros unicornis; Thamin Deer — Cervus eldi.

subject: General Studies
question: Who discovered the natural classification system of plants ?
explanation: Go with option B. Bentham and Hooker's *Genera Plantarum* laid out a natural classification of flowering plants by affinity — Theophrastus and Linnaeus came earlier; G.M. Smith worked on algae.

subject: General Studies
question: In Agriculture, groundwater is tapped by _______.
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Farmers reach groundwater by sinking tubewells or bore wells into the aquifer — canals, ponds, and tanks store or convey surface water instead.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following animal group/groups was/were the first vertebrate to become adapted to life on land ?

options.A: Only c and d (Mammals and Aves)
options.B: Only b and d (Amphibians and Aves)

explanation: On this one, option D. Amphibians were the first vertebrates to colonise land, bridging aquatic and terrestrial life — reptiles, birds, and mammals adapted later.

subject: Science
question: Which of the following is the causal organism of Wheat Rust disease ?
explanation: Pick option A. Wheat rust is caused by the fungus *Puccinia graminis* tritici — the classic black/stem rust pathogen — not citrus, sorghum, or grape downy-mildew organisms.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following cholesterol is considered as good cholesterol ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. HDL cholesterol carries excess cholesterol back to the liver for disposal — the 'good' fraction — whereas LDL and VLDL raise arterial risk.

subject: Science
question: When kidney tubular reabsorption fails, copious urination follows. What is this disease (metabolic disorder) called ?
explanation: The right pick is option B. When kidney tubules fail to reabsorb water, the patient passes huge volumes of dilute urine — diabetes insipidus — not the sugar-driven polyuria of diabetes mellitus.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following vaccine is administered by oral route ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Sabin polio vaccine is given orally (OPV); BCG, Salk polio, and MMR are injected routes.

subject: General Studies
question: Srikant stands facing north on the ground. He turns right and travels 30 km. Then he turns left and travels 20 km. Again he turns right and travels 40 km. Again he turns right and travels 35 km. Which direction is he facing now ?
explanation: On this one, option D. From North: right to East (30 km), left to North (20 km), right to East (40 km), right to South (35 km) — he ends facing South.

subject: General Studies
question: A devotee, while going to pray in the temple, put flowers on each step that indicated its number. When he offered 9 flowers to God, he had 17 flowers in balance. If the temple had 24 steps, then how many flowers did the devotee have ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Flowers on steps 1 through 24 total 1+2+…+24 = 300; after offering 9 to God and keeping 17, the devotee started with 300+9+17 = 326 flowers.

subject: General Studies
question: In a class of 100 students, 40 students passed in Mathematics and 60 passed in English. 8 students failed in both Mathematics and English. How many students passed in both the subjects ?
explanation: Go with option C. Eight failed both, so 92 passed at least one subject; both-pass = Maths + English − at least one = 40+60−92 = 8.

subject: General Studies
question: There are 8 points in a plane, no three of which are collinear. If lines are drawn by joining two points, how many such lines would be drawn ?
explanation: Pick option D. With 8 points and no three collinear, every line joins two points — number of lines = ⁸C₂ = 8×7/2 = 28.

subject: General Studies
question: Niraj's watch is fast by 5½ minutes in a day. Piyush's watch lags behind by 35 seconds per hour. If their watches indicated the same time at 8 o'clock in the morning, then by how many minutes would Neeraj's watch be ahead of Piyush's watch that night at 12 o'clock ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. From 8 a.m. to midnight is 16 hours: Niraj's watch gains 5½ × (16/24) = 11/3 minutes, and Piyush's loses 35 × 16 ÷ 60 = 28/3 minutes — together 13 minutes ahead.

subject: General Studies
question: By which Venn-diagram can the given sets of words be shown ? Teachers, Writers, Married persons.

options.C: Two overlapping circles with one separate

explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Some teachers are writers, some writers are married, and each set can overlap the others — three mutually intersecting circles capture all three possibilities.

subject: General Studies
question: If A = 1, B = 2, C = 3, ....., Z = 26, then how will you write the word 'GODFATHER' ?
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Letter values G-O-D-F-A-T-H-E-R give 7-15-4-6-1-20-8-5-18 — match each alphabet position to its number in order.

subject: General Studies
question: In the following question, events I and II are given. You have to read both carefully and decide their nature of relationship. You have to assume that the given information in I and II are true and decide the correct answer. Events : I. Mr. Hari was killed in a fire. II. A fire broke out in the company. Answer Options :

options.A: I is the effect and II is its principal cause.
options.B: II is the effect and I is its principal cause.
options.C: II is the effect, but I is not its principal cause.
options.D: None of the above is correct.

explanation: The right pick is option D. A company fire and Mr Hari's death in some fire are separate facts — without proof they are the same incident, no option correctly fixes cause and effect.

subject: General Studies
question: Find the odd man out from the following numbers : 343, 324, 3375, 10648, 64
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. 343, 3375, 10648 and 64 are perfect cubes (7³, 15³, 22³, 4³); 324 = 18² is a square, not a cube — the odd one out.

subject: Reasoning
question: Niraj covered the first 20 km distance, out of a total of 60 km, at a speed of 10 km/hr, the next 20 km distance at 12 km/hr and the remaining 20 km distance at 15 km/hr. What is the average speed of Niraj to cover the 60 km distance ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Time for three equal 20 km legs: 20/10 + 20/12 + 20/15 = 5 hours total; average speed = 60 ÷ 5 = 12 km/hr.

subject: General Studies
question: The simple interest and compound interest for 2 years of a sum is ₹ 1,800 and ₹ 1,890 respectively. What is the rate of interest per cent per annum ?
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. CI minus SI for 2 years equals P(r/100)²; with SI = 1800 giving Pr/50 = 1800, the extra ₹90 fixes r at 10% per annum.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following is in descending order ?
explanation: The right pick is option C. As decimals: 9/13 ≈ 0.692, 11/17 ≈ 0.647, 5/8 = 0.625 — descending order is 9/13, then 11/17, then 5/8.

subject: General Studies
question: Neha can do a work in 6 days and Rekha can do it in 18 days. How many days would it take them to do the same work if they worked together ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Combined rate 1/6 + 1/18 = 2/9 per day, so Neha and Rekha finish together in 9/2 = 4.5 days.

subject: General Studies
question: On reducing the entry fee by 35% in a park, the number of visitors increased by 40%. Then the percent increase or decrease in the income from the entry fee is
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. New revenue = 0.65 × 1.40 = 0.91 of the original — a 9% decrease, not a simple 5% net change.

subject: Reasoning
question: According to the report of the National Crime Registration Department, the information related to Child Crime is as follows : a. In the year 2018, 109 children were sexually abused every day. b. 39827 such incidents were reported in 2018. c. In 2018, there were 21401 incidents of rape of girls. d. The highest 2832 incidents of rape on children occurred in Maharashtra (2018). Which of the above statements are correct ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. All four statements match the NCRB 2018 child-crime figures cited in that year's report — daily abuse count, total incidents, girl rape cases and Maharashtra's top rank.

subject: General Studies
question: The schools, colleges, universities, educational as well as private institutions may witness historical places. Keeping this aim in view, which is the first State in India that decided to set up 'Jail Tourism' ?
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Maharashtra was the first State to launch 'Jail Tourism', opening historic prisons for students and visitors to learn from the freedom struggle.

subject: General Studies
question: Department of AIDS control has been merged with _______ and now it is known as National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO).

options.B: Department of Health and Family Welfare

explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. The erstwhile Department of AIDS Control was merged into the Department of Health and Family Welfare and now functions as NACO under that ministry.

subject: Science
question: Following is the work of Dinabandhu Sahu, honoured by NIRI : a. A book of 'Farming the Ocean' on sea algae. b. Production of short film 'Biodiversity of Life' based on Mary Kom. c. Fellowship and Research in International Society for Energy Environment and Sustainability. d. Sea farm training based on Project Chilika. Which of the above sentences is/are incorrect ?
explanation: The right pick is option B. Dinabandhu Sahu's sea-algae book, ISEES fellowship and Chilika sea-farm training are credited to him; the Mary Kom biodiversity short film is not — only statement (b) is wrong.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following are characteristics of GSAT-30 ? a. Weight – 3357 kg b. Provides high quality Television, Telecommunication and Broadcast services c. Equipped with 12C, 12Ku Band Transponder d. High quality communication satellite Answer Options :
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. GSAT-30 weighed about 3357 kg, carried 12 C and 12 Ku-band transponders, and served TV, telecom and broadcast needs as a high-quality communication satellite — all four points hold.

subject: General Studies
question: Which of the following novels written by Sonali Navangul has won the 'Marathi Sahitya Akademi Award' in 2021 ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. Sonali Navangul's novel 'Madhyaratrinantarche Taas' won the Marathi Sahitya Akademi Award in 2021.

subject: General Studies
question: Lionel Messi was selected for which of the following awards in 2021 for the seventh time ?

options.C: World Soccer Player of the Year

explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Lionel Messi won the Ballon d'Or in 2021 — his record seventh time — not the Golden Shoe or FIFA's differently named player awards.

subject: Economy
question: Winner of the Nobel Prize for Economics (2019), Abhijeet Banerjee's life journey till date is given in points below. Reorder them and choose the correct option. a. Contributed in preparation of Scheme Nyuntam Aay Yojana (NYAY) for poverty eradication in India. b. Written a book titled 'Poor Economics'. c. Received the Infosys Prize. d. Studied economics at Presidency College, Kolkata. Answer Options :
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Chronology: economics at Presidency College, Kolkata (d) → Infosys Prize (c) → 'Poor Economics' (b) → NYAY scheme work (a).

subject: Polity
question: On the eve of 75th Independence day, who was honoured with the peacetime Gallantry Award — 'Ashoka Chakra' ? a. ASI Babu Ram b. Police Constable Altaf Hussain c. Lt. Governor Girish Chandra Murmu d. Governor of Mizoram, P.S. Shreedharan Pillai Answer Options :
explanation: The right pick is option D. On the 75th Independence Day peacetime gallantry list, ASI Babu Ram alone received the Ashoka Chakra among the names given — not the other three.

subject: General Studies
question: Under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) (PMAY-U), as on 18th January, 2021 _______ houses have been sanctioned.
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. PMAY-U data as on 18 January 2021 put total sanctioned houses at about 109.2 lakh — the figure the answer key selects.

subject: General Studies
question: Consider the following statements : a. Kiwi is India's first certified organic fruit. b. Arunachal Pradesh is the first State in the country to obtain an organic certification for its Kiwis. Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Kiwi is India's first certified organic fruit, and Arunachal Pradesh was the first State to obtain organic certification for its kiwi crop — both statements stand.

subject: General Studies
question: In which year did Avani Chaturvedi, Bhawana Kanth and Mohana Singh create history by becoming the first women pilots to be commissioned into the fighter stream of Indian Air Force ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Avani Chaturvedi, Bhawana Kanth and Mohana Singh were commissioned as the IAF's first women fighter pilots in 2016.

subject: General Studies
question: Which Space agency has launched the first all-electric experimental aircraft 'X-57 Maxwell' ?
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. NASA developed and tested the all-electric experimental aircraft X-57 Maxwell — not ISRO, LAPAN or CNES.

subject: General Studies
question: Which artificial satellite was launched by India on 11th December, 2019 through PSLV – C48 launcher ?
explanation: The right pick is option A. PSLV-C48 on 11 December 2019 placed RISAT-2BR1 into orbit along with nine customer satellites.

subject: General Studies
question: Select the right option regarding the Chairperson of 93rd Akhil Bhartiya Marathi Sahitya Sammelan, Senior Literary Author and Thinker, Father Francis Dibrito's life happenings till date. a. National Award for translation of 'Subodh Bible – Nava Karar' book by Sahitya Academy. b. Chairperson of 15th Marathi Christi Sahitya Sammelan in Pune. c. The ordination as a Catholic priest. d. Chief Editor of newsletter 'Suvarta'. Answer Options :
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. Father Francis Dibrito's timeline runs: ordination as priest (c) → chief editor of 'Suvarta' (d) → chair of the 15th Marathi Christi Sahitya Sammelan, Pune (b) → Sahitya Akademi translation award for 'Subodh Bible – Nava Karar' (a).

subject: General Studies
question: महाराष्ट्र ग्राम पंचायत अधिनियमातील 'ग्राम विकास समित्या' संबंधीच्या तरतुदी बाबत खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या : अ. ग्राम विकास समितीतील सदस्यांची एकूण संख्या सातपेक्षा कमी नसेल आणि सतरा पेक्षा जास्त नसेल. ब. ग्राम विकास समितीतील सदस्यांपैकी एकूतीयांशापेक्षा कमी नसतील इतके सदस्य ग्राम पंचायतीच्या सदस्यांमधील असतील. क. तिच्या सदस्यांपैकी एक द्वितीयांशापेक्षा कमी नसतील इतके सदस्य महिला असतील. ड. उप सरपंच हा तिचा पदसिद्ध अध्यक्ष असेल. ई. ग्रामसेवक हा तिचा पदसिद्ध सदस्य-सचिव असेल. वरीलपैकी कोणती विधाने योग्य आहेत ?

options.A: फक्त अ, ब, क आणि ड
options.C: फक्त अ, ब, क आणि ई

explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. Village Development Committee मध्ये किमान एक-third सदस्य Gram Panchayat मधून, अर्धे महिला, आणि Gram Sevak ex-officio member-secretary — (b), (c), (e). (a) मधील सदस्य संख्येची मर्यादा आणि (d) मध्ये Deputy Sarpanch ला ex-officio chairman करणे कायद्याशी जुळत नाही.

subject: General Studies
question: खालील विधाने विचारात घ्या : अ. सरपंचावे (ज्याची निवड ग्राम पंचायतीच्या सभासदांकडून झालेली आहे) अथवा उपसरपंचावे, रिक्त (राजीनामामुळे) झालेले पद ते रिक्त झाल्याच्या दिनांका पासून तीस दिवसांच्या आत भरले पाहिजे. ब. थेट जनतेमार्फत निवडलेल्या सरपंचावे रिक्त झालेले पद ते रिक्त झाल्याच्या दिनांका पासून तीन महिन्यांच्या आत भरले पाहिजे. क. ग्राम पंचायतीच्या ज्या सदस्याचे पद सतत ग्राम पंचायतीच्या सभेला गैरहजर राहण्याच्या कारणास्तव रिकामे झाले असेल तर तो लगेच पुन्हा निवडून येण्यास पात्र नसतो. वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान/ने बरोबर आहे/आहेत ?
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय A येतो. Maharashtra Gram Panchayat नियमांनुसार resignation मुळे Sarpanch किंवा Upa-Sarpanch पद रिक्त झाल्यास ते तीस दिवसांत भरावे लागते — विधान (a) बरोबर. थेट निवडलेल्या Sarpanch च्या रिक्त जागेस (b) मधील तीन महिन्यांचा नियम लागत नाही, आणि सलग सभा गैरहजरी (c) प्रमाणे re-election अपात्रता निर्माण करत नाही.

subject: Polity
question: 'सरकारिया आयोग' _________ यासाठी अनुकूल होते.
explanation: येथे खात्रीशीर उत्तर पर्याय D. Sarkaria Commission (1983) ने Centre–State relations पाहिले आणि सहकार्य मजबूत करण्याची शिफारस केली — Governor, All India Services किंवा Inter-State Council रद्द करण्याचे ते समर्थन करत नव्हते. तीनही पर्याय अशी रद्दीची मागणी सांगतात जी Commission ने केली नाही.

subject: General Studies
question: राज्याच्या महाधिवक्त्यासंबंधी खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान बरोबर आहे ?

options.A: तो राज्याच्या मंत्री परिषदेची इच्छा असेपर्यंत आपल्या पदावर राहू शकतो.
options.B: त्याचे मानधन राज्य विधिमंडळाद्वारे निश्चित केले जाते.
options.C: तो राज्यशासना विरुद्ध असलेल्या खटल्यात खाजगी पक्षकारासाठी वकील म्हणून उभा राहू शकतो.

explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D. Advocate General Governor च्या pleasure वर पद धरतो (Council of Ministers वर नाही), वेतन Governor ठरवतो (Legislature नाही), आणि तो private party साठी State Government विरुद्ध वकिली करू शकत नाही — म्हणून (A)–(C) पैकी काहीही उभे राहत नाही.

subject: Polity
question: विधान (अ) : संसदीय पद्धतीमध्ये प्रशासनावरील कायदेमंडळाचे नियंत्रण अध्यक्षीय पद्धतीपेक्षा भिन्न असते. कारण (ब) : प्रशासनावर कायदेमंडळाचे नियंत्रण हे लोकसत्ताक शासनाचे महत्त्वाचे वैशिष्ट्य आहे.

options.A: 'अ' आणि 'ब' दोन्हीही बरोबर आणि 'ब' हे 'अ' चे योग्य स्पष्टीकरण आहे.
options.B: 'अ' आणि 'ब' दोन्हीही बरोबर, परंतु 'ब' हे 'अ' चे योग्य स्पष्टीकरण नाही.
options.C: 'अ' हे बरोबर आहे, परंतु 'ब' हे चुकीचे आहे.
options.D: 'अ' हे चुकीचे आहे, परंतु 'ब' हे बरोबर आहे.

explanation: या प्रश्नात पर्याय B. दोन्ही विधाने खरे: parliamentary व presidential प्रणाली executive वर legislative control वेगळ्या पद्धतीने करतात, आणि लोकशाहीत असे नियंत्रण असते. पण (B) सामान्य लोकशाही तथ्य सांगते — दोन प्रणाली का वेगळ्या आहेत हे स्पष्ट करत नाही, म्हणून (A) चे योग्य स्पष्टीकरण नाही.

subject: Polity
question: भारतीय संसदेला राज्यसूचीतील कोणत्याही विषयाबाबत राष्ट्रीय हितासाठी कायदा करण्याचा अधिकार आहे जर तसंबंधी _________ ने ठराव मंजूर केला तर.

options.A: लोकसभेने तिच्या एकूण सदस्य संख्येच्या बहुमताने
options.B: लोकसभेने तिच्या एकूण सदस्य संख्येच्या दोन-तृतीयांश पेक्षा कमी नाही इतक्या बहुमताने
options.C: राज्यसभेने तिच्या एकूण सदस्य संख्येच्या बहुमताने
options.D: राज्यसभेने हजर राहून मतदान करणाऱ्या दोन-तृतीयांश सदस्य संख्येपेक्षा कमी नाही इतक्या बहुमताने

explanation: पर्याय D निवडा. Article 249 नुसार State List विषयावर Parliament ला कायदा करण्याचा अधिकार Rajya Sabha च्या resolution ने मिळतो — उपस्थित व मतदान करणाऱ्यांच्या किमान दोन-third बहुमताने; Lok Sabha चे साधे बहुमत किंवा Rajya Sabha च्या एकूण सदस्यांपैकी दोन-third नाही.

subject: Polity
question: 'अर्थ विधेयका' बाबतीत खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान/ने बरोबर आहे/आहेत ? अ. ते मंत्री किंवा खाजगी सदस्य मांडू शकतो. ब. ते राज्यपालांच्या शिफारशी शिवाय मांडता येत नाही. क. एखादे विधेयक अर्थ विधेयक आहे किंवा नाही असा प्रश्न उपस्थित झाल्यास राज्यपालांचा अंतिम निर्णय असतो. ड. जर दोन्ही सभागृहांमध्ये अर्थ विधेयका बाबत पेच निर्माण झाल्यास राज्यपाल विधानसभा आणि विधान परिषदेची संयुक्त बैठक बोलावू शकतात. पर्यायी उत्तरे :
explanation: पर्याय B निवडा. राज्यस्तरावर Money Bill फक्त Governor च्या recommendation वरच सादर होऊ शकते — फक्त (b). Private member सादर करू शकत नाही ((a) चुकीचे), money-bill वाद Speaker ठरवतो Governor नाही ((c) चुकीचे), आणि state money-bill deadlock साठी joint sitting मार्ग नाही ((d) चुकीचे).

subject: History
question: राज्यघटना निर्मितीची जबाबदारी व कार्ये पार पाडण्यासाठी घटनासमितीने विविध समित्या स्थापन केल्या होत्या. त्यात कार्यपद्धतीविषयक नियम समितीचे अध्यक्ष म्हणून खालीलपैकी कोणी काम केले ?
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय C येतो. Dr Rajendra Prasad यांनी Constituent Assembly च्या Rules of Procedure Committee चे अध्यक्षपद सांभाळले. Ambedkar Drafting Committee अध्यक्ष; Alladi Krishnaswami Ayyar व K.M. Munshi drafting कामात होते, पण या विशिष्ट committee चे अध्यक्ष नव्हते.
